name: Diego Cortina Autrey
bio: Diego Cortina Autrey is known for Roma (2018) and Road to Roma (2020).

credits.title: GDL
credits.overview: GDL is a Mexican dark comedy-drama film set in Guadalajara. We meet Daniel Lurdez, a young man who, after arriving in the city, ends up in a psychologist’s office. credits.title: Road to Roma
credits.overview: Director Alfonso Cuarón reflects on the childhood memories, period details and creative choices that shaped his Academy Award-winning film 'ROMA.'

credits.title: Roma
credits.overview: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.
